name: jobs
description: Job records: status, operation, inputs, outputs, errors, timing and provenance. Load to find out what happened to failed, pending, stuck or completed work without rerunning it.

content.inline:
# Job audit

Jobs are durable execution records under `j/`. List or inspect `j` to find IDs, then read `j/<id>` for the exact record. Use slice or aggregate for large histories. A record identifies the operation, caller, input, status and timestamps, plus output or error when terminal; its `prev` chain preserves earlier states.

Use job-status to poll a known job without starting work. Use job-result to obtain a known job's result; check status first and use a bounded wait for non-terminal work. Read-only operations may intentionally leave no durable job.

Do not diagnose by rerunning the operation. Distinguish a long-running `STARTED` job from a failed one, and report observed state separately from inference.
